caption: The video captures an aerial view over the lip of a large waterfall, where a sheet of white, aerated water pours over a dark rocky edge on the left and drops into a mist-filled void. To the right, the river churns into frothy rapids before the drop, broken by dark outcrops and a cluster of green bushes on a central rock. The falling cascade deforms as vertical white streaks shift, merge, and break while descending, and the boundary between sheet and void changes shape. Bright foam patches advance toward the lip and vanish over it, while a tall column of spray billows along the far-left edge, its outline fluctuating. The vegetation and corner rocks stay fixed, so the visible motion belongs to water and mist. The flow is already underway and continues past the last frame.
